name: Tourist Entry (Post-March 2026 Restructuring)

requirements.blocker_text: Effective 3 March 2026, Nicaragua restructured its visa system into two categories: (A) visa-exempt, and (C) Consulted Visa, requiring prior authorization from Nicaragua's Immigration Department before a consulate can issue it (processing roughly 30 days or longer, generally permitting an initial 90-day stay). This reform moved 128 countries from visa-free or simple-consular status into the Category C requirement, while at least 9 other nationalities were newly reclassified as visa-exempt. Diplomatic, official, service, public-affairs, and special passport holders may retain exemptions where a valid bilateral agreement with Nicaragua exists.
requirements.fix_path: For Category C nationalities, apply for a Consulted Visa well in advance of travel, since Immigration Department authorization can take 30+ days.

sources.title: Fragomen (immigration law firm) -- Nicaragua's March 2026 visa category restructuring: 128 nationalities moved to Category C (Consulted Visa), 9 reclassified as visa-exempt, processing and stay details
Consortium Legal (law firm) -- corroborating coverage of the same visa-category restructuring and new Consulted Visa procedure
